name: Align
summary: Word-timestamp refinement for any transcript, on device, from 0.7MB.
output: { words: [{ text, start, end }] } aligned against the audio

tool.name: align_transcript
tool.description: Refine word-level timestamps in a transcript against its audio, for accurate captions, cuts and highlights.

params.audio_path: Absolute path to the audio or video file.
params.transcript: The transcript text to align against the audio.

tool.returns: The transcript split into words, each with a start and end time in seconds.

skill.name: desert-ant-align
skill.description: Align transcript words to audio timestamps with the Desert Ant Align model.
skill.whenToUse: Use when captions, cuts or highlight spans need word-accurate timing rather than coarse segment times.

name: Clear
summary: On-device speech enhancement: denoise, dereverb and loudness-normalize to 48 kHz.
output: A cleaned audio file path plus processing metadata

tool.name: enhance_speech
tool.description: Clean up a recording on device: remove noise and room echo and level the loudness to a podcast-ready 48 kHz.

params.audio_path: Absolute path to the input audio or video file.
params.output_path: Absolute path to write the enhanced audio to.

tool.returns: The path of the enhanced audio file.

skill.name: desert-ant-clear
skill.description: Enhance noisy speech recordings on device with the Desert Ant Clear model.
skill.whenToUse: Use when a recording needs denoising, dereverberation or loudness normalization before publication.

name: Clips
summary: Clip selection that turns a long recording into ranked shorts and highlights from a transcript.
output: { clips: [{ index, start, end, title, file }] } ranked by interest

tool.name: select_clips
tool.description: Rank and cut the most interesting short clips and highlights out of a podcast, interview or meeting recording.

params.media_path: Absolute path to the recording to cut clips from.
params.transcript: Optional pre-computed transcript JSON, so transcription runs only once.

tool.returns: Ranked clips, each with its start and end time, a title and the written clip file.

skill.name: desert-ant-clips
skill.description: Select and cut ranked short clips from long recordings with the Desert Ant Clips model.
skill.whenToUse: Use when a long recording must become shorts, highlights or a social cut list.

name: Ear
summary: On-device spoken language identification across 102 languages from a short audio stretch.

tool.name: detect_spoken_language
tool.description: Identify which language is being spoken in a recording, before transcription starts, across 102 languages.

params.audio_path: Absolute path to the audio or video file.

tool.returns: The detected spoken language with a confidence and runner-up candidates.

skill.name: desert-ant-ear
skill.description: Identify the spoken language of a recording on device with the Desert Ant Ear model.
skill.whenToUse: Use to pick a transcription language or route audio before running speech recognition.

name: Emo
summary: Type a task or message and get the emoji that fit, in 22 languages, on the device.

tool.name: suggest_emoji
tool.description: Suggest emoji that fit a piece of text, in 22 languages, running entirely on device.

params.text: The text to suggest emoji for.

limit.description: Maximum number of suggestions to return (default 5).

tool.returns: Ranked emoji suggestions with confidence scores.

skill.name: desert-ant-emo
skill.description: Suggest fitting emoji for text with the Desert Ant Emo model.
skill.whenToUse: Use when writing release notes, commit summaries or UI copy that should carry emoji.

name: Eye
summary: On-device frame scoring that tells you which shot to keep, what is in it, and which shots repeat.

tool.name: score_frames
tool.description: Score a burst or clip of frames to choose the best shot, describe what is in it and detect repeated shots.

image_paths.description: Absolute paths of the frames to score.

top.description: How many top frames to return (default 5).

tool.returns: Frames ranked by score, with labels and duplicate grouping.

skill.name: desert-ant-eye
skill.description: Score and rank frames to pick the best shot with the Desert Ant Eye model.
skill.whenToUse: Use when a burst or clip must be reduced to the best shot or de-duplicated.

name: Face
summary: On-device face matching that finds the same person across a photo library or through a video.

tool.name: match_faces
tool.description: Match the same person across a set of images or a video, entirely on device, with no image leaving the machine.

image_paths.description: Absolute paths of the images to match faces across.

params.video_path: Optional video to track faces through instead of still images.

tool.returns: Detected face boxes grouped by person identity.

skill.name: desert-ant-face
skill.description: Match and group the same person across images with the Desert Ant Face model.
skill.whenToUse: Use to group a photo set by person, or to find a person's appearances in footage, without uploading images.

name: Gist
summary: On-device topic tagging across a 36-topic taxonomy, in 101 languages, with no server call.

tool.name: tag_topics
tool.description: Tag a title, post or article with the topics it covers, from a fixed 36-topic taxonomy across 101 languages.

limit.description: Maximum number of topics to return (default 5).

tool.returns: Ranked topic labels from the fixed taxonomy with scores.

skill.name: desert-ant-gist
skill.description: Tag content with topics from a fixed taxonomy using the Desert Ant Gist model.
skill.whenToUse: Use to classify or route content into a stable topic taxonomy before indexing or display.

name: Moderator
summary: On-device NSFW detection that flags nudity before upload, trained only on licensed and synthetic data.

tool.name: detect_nsfw
tool.description: Check images for nudity or sexual content on device before they are uploaded or shown.

image_paths.description: Absolute paths of the images to check.

tool.returns: A per-image NSFW verdict with score and labels.

skill.name: desert-ant-moderator
skill.description: Screen images for NSFW content on device with the Desert Ant Moderator model.
skill.whenToUse: Use to gate user-supplied images before storing, publishing or sending them anywhere.

name: Redact
summary: On-device redaction that strips personal data as you type, in 27 languages, with restore support.
output: { redactedText, items: [{ label, original, placeholder, confidence }] }

tool.name: redact_pii
tool.description: Replace personal data (names, emails, phone numbers, addresses, card numbers and more) in text with stable placeholders, on device, before the text reaches any remote service.

labels.description: Optional list of entity labels to restrict redaction to, for example ["EMAIL", "PHONE"].

tool.returns: The redacted text plus the placeholder map, so originals can be restored after a remote round trip.

skill.name: desert-ant-redact
skill.description: Strip personal data from text on device with the Desert Ant Redact model before sending it to any remote service.
skill.whenToUse: Use before sending logs, transcripts, tickets or documents containing names, emails or numbers to a remote model or API.

name: Schemer
summary: Extract typed fields from any text against your own schema, on device, with empty fields left empty.
output: An object matching the caller-supplied schema

tool.name: extract_fields
tool.description: Extract typed fields from text against a caller-supplied JSON schema, on device, leaving a field empty where the text says nothing.

params.schema: A JSON Schema object describing the fields to extract.

tool.returns: An object matching the supplied schema.

skill.name: desert-ant-schemer
skill.description: Extract schema-constrained structured fields from text with the Desert Ant Schemer model.
skill.whenToUse: Use when text must become typed JSON against a known schema without a round trip to a hosted model.

name: Shapes
summary: On-device shape recognition that turns one hand-drawn stroke into a rectangle, ellipse, triangle, star or line in under 10ms.

tool.name: recognize_shape
tool.description: Turn a single hand-drawn stroke into a clean shape: rectangle, ellipse, triangle, star or line.

params.points: The stroke as an array of [x, y] points in drawing order.
params.closed: Whether the stroke is a closed shape.

tool.returns: The recognized shape with a confidence and runner-up candidates.

skill.name: desert-ant-shapes
skill.description: Recognize hand-drawn strokes as clean shapes with the Desert Ant Shapes model.
skill.whenToUse: Use in drawing or diagram tooling to snap an ink stroke to a geometric shape.

name: Title
summary: On-device titles and descriptions: a short factual title and a one- or two-sentence description for any passage.

tool.name: suggest_title
tool.description: Write a short factual title and a one- or two-sentence description for a passage of text: a landing-page section, a documentation page or an article.
tool.returns: A title and a description, or an empty card when the model returned neither.

skill.name: desert-ant-title
skill.description: Generate short factual titles and descriptions for passages with the Desert Ant Title model.
skill.whenToUse: Use when page sections, docs headings or article summaries need a title and one-line description.

name: Tongue
summary: On-device language identification for short text across 84 languages, from just a few words.
output: { language, reliability, candidates: [{ language, probability }], isTooCloseToCall }

tool.name: lang_detect
tool.description: Identify the language of a short piece of text across 84 languages, on device, in microseconds. Works from as little as three words.

params.text: The text whose language to identify.

top.description: How many runner-up language candidates to include (default 3).

tool.returns: The detected language code, a reliability verdict, and the top scoring candidates with probabilities.

skill.name: desert-ant-tongue
skill.description: Detect the language of short text on device with the Desert Ant Tongue model.
skill.whenToUse: Use before translating, routing to a locale-specific template, or checking that generated copy is in the expected language.

name: Toxic
summary: On-device moderation that flags hateful, abusive and threatening text in 23 European languages.

tool.name: moderate_text
tool.description: Flag hateful, abusive and threatening text in 23 European languages, on device, before the message is sent.
tool.returns: A toxicity verdict with score and the matched labels.

skill.name: desert-ant-toxic
skill.description: Screen text for hate speech and abuse on device with the Desert Ant Toxic model.
skill.whenToUse: Use to pre-screen user-generated text before publishing or forwarding it.

name: Uhm
summary: On-device filler detection that marks every um, uh and hmm to within 20ms, an hour of audio in 12s.
output: [{ start, end, word }] filler spans to cut

tool.name: detect_fillers
tool.description: Find every um, uh and hmm in a recording with the exact span to cut.

params.audio_path: Absolute path to the audio or video file.

tool.returns: Filler spans with start and end times in seconds, ready to cut.

skill.name: desert-ant-uhm
skill.description: Detect filler words in speech on device with the Desert Ant Uhm model.
skill.whenToUse: Use when editing spoken audio to remove hesitations and tighten a transcript.

name: Voz
summary: Transcribe 10 minutes of audio in 2s on an iPhone, 14x faster than Whisper, with word timestamps.
output: { text, words: [{ text, start, end }], realtimeFactor }

tool.name: transcribe_audio
tool.description: Transcribe an audio or video file on device with word-level timestamps across 25 languages. Nothing is uploaded and no API key is needed.

params.audio_path: Absolute path to the audio or video file, or a 16 kHz mono WAV.

include_words.description: Whether to include the per-word timestamps (default true).

tool.returns: The transcript text, optional per-word start and end times, and the measured realtime factor.

skill.name: desert-ant-voz
skill.description: Transcribe audio on device with word timestamps using the Desert Ant Voz model.
skill.whenToUse: Use to get a transcript or captions from a recording locally, without uploading audio to a hosted API.

name: Who
summary: On-device speaker labeling that turns a recording into per-person turns with face boxes and timestamps.

tool.name: detect_speakers
tool.description: Split a recording into per-person speaking turns with timestamps and face boxes, ready to cut or caption.

params.audio_path: Absolute path to the audio or video file.

tool.returns: Speaking turns labelled by speaker, with start and end times.

skill.name: desert-ant-who
skill.description: Label speaker turns in a recording on device with the Desert Ant Who model.
skill.whenToUse: Use when a transcript or edit needs to know who spoke when.
